en.北京航空航天大学计算机学院直博生: PhD student in Computer Science · Beihang University
en.研究人如何在虚拟与物理世界中更自然地感知、交互与行动。当前聚焦具身智能、VR/A: I study how people perceive, interact and act in virtual and physical environments. My current work spans embodied AI, VR/AR, human–computer interaction, and knowledge-driven assembly and disassembly planning.
en.让交互方法连接感知、推理与行动。: Connecting perception, reasoning and action through interaction.
en.从 VR 输入与多物体操控出发，向具身数据、知识表示和可执行规划延伸。工作覆盖方: My work began with VR input and multi-object manipulation and now extends to embodied data, knowledge representation and executable planning. I develop methods and systems, run user studies and evaluate physical feasibility.
en.以装配知识图组织几何和语义证据，让 LLM 生成候选动作，再由物理仿真验证并反馈: Organize geometric and semantic evidence in assembly knowledge graphs, use LLMs to propose actions, and verify and refine them through physical simulation.
en.研究触控、眼动和裸手输入，面向文本输入、多对象选择、空间布局及协作任务设计交互范: Design touch, gaze and bare-hand interactions for text entry, multi-object selection, spatial arrangement and collaboration.
en.实践多相机采集、手部三维感知、机器人 Retargeting、Android 端: Build multi-camera capture systems, 3D hand perception, robot retargeting, on-device Android applications and AI agent platforms.
en.如何让语言模型给出的拆卸计划，不只“合理”，而且真实可执行？: How can we make language-model disassembly plans physically executable?
en.当前研究从 CAD 装配体提取接触关系与几何属性，并补充部件功能和装配语义。规划: I extract contact relationships and geometric attributes from CAD assemblies and enrich them with part functions and assembly semantics. A planner proposes sequences from structured states; a simulator checks collisions and blocking, then returns failure evidence for the next reasoning step.
en.围绕沉浸式交互与多模态感知展开。以下列出 6 篇已发表论文，提供方法讲解、实验说: Six published papers on immersive interaction and multimodal perception. Each page explains the method, experimental evidence and citation details.
en.FanPad VR 文本输入演示封面: FanPad text entry with two controller touchpads in VR
en.面向 VR 手柄触控板的扇形键盘。以熟悉的 26 键布局和拇指运动范围平衡效率与: A fan-shaped keyboard for VR controller touchpads. A familiar 26-key layout follows the thumb's range of motion for efficient, comfortable input.
en.MOA 多对象布局 VR 场景: Multi-object arrangement in an MOA VR scene
en.场景感知的 VR 多对象布局方法。结合眼动和裸手输入，降低高遮挡条件下选择与整理: Scene-aware multi-object arrangement in VR. Gaze and bare-hand input reduce the effort of selecting and arranging objects under heavy occlusion.

en.观看 Android 运动助手演示: Watch the Android sports assistant demo
en.面向运动场景的移动端原型，串联动作输入、视觉识别与即时结果展示。: A mobile prototype that connects motion input, visual recognition and immediate feedback for sports activities.
en.观看 Pico 4 Pro 裸手识别测试: Watch the Pico 4 Pro hand-tracking test
en.在真实操作场景中观察头显原生手部追踪的识别范围、遮挡表现与交互稳定性。: Test the headset's native hand tracking during interaction, examining its tracking range, occlusion behavior and stability.
en.研究之外，持续把方法落成可用系统。: Alongside research, I build systems that put methods into practice.
